headline: A 1999 executive order aimed at increasing Asian American and Pacific Islander participation in federal programs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to work on increasing how much Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders take part in, and benefit from, federal programs. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, offices, or deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at increasing their participation in federal programs.
Agencies that run federal programs would likely be expected to take steps to reach these communities, though the details are not given in the source.
